notes: No ad-free copy exists for this show (Megaphone), so every region was labelled by reading. The feed's itunes:duration is 5,288 s and this copy is 5,339 s, so about 51 s were stitched in at download time. The ~50 s Hoop and Huddle promo (11:23-12:08) is the only single piece of that length, so it may be the stitched-in part; which pieces are baked in is unverified, so no region is marked 'inserted'.

How the edges were judged: YMH breaks cut straight from conversation into the spot with no hand-off, so each read starts on its first line and ends on its last URL/disclaimer line ('See website for full details', 'Look for Mountain Dew in stores near you'). The conversation on both sides of each break joins up seamlessly.

Mountain Dew runs twice back to back (two voices, near-identical script), scored as two regions in one group. The second read's start is anchored 'start_after' the first read's last line because both reads open with the same words.
The 4 s 'Well, welcome' sting at 0:01 is EITHER, and the Rocket Mortgage pre-roll has a 12 s start slack, so a cut from 0:00 is right too. The music tail 0:05-0:11 cannot be reached by line anchors.

The real theme ('Yo mama. Well, welcome...', 18:54) has Christina and Duncan talking over it about changing the intro; it is INTRO up to 'You guys cool? Yeah.' (19:25). The music runs on about 10 s without speech to 'No, no, no' (19:35), which line anchors cannot reach.

The fan closing song ('Fartin' by Terry Nova, a listed chapter) after the goodbyes is OUTRO; EITHER would also be defensible. The final Porosos spot is the hosts' own vodka brand, so SELF_PROMOTION with ADVERTISEMENT allowed.

Traps kept as NORMAL: Duncan's joke 'sorry to plug my own stuff... I do offer a seminar' (55:54), the Heaven's Gate Nike 'product placement' riff (32:08), and the robot-duck YouTube clip with its $400 price talk (1:10:55).
